tools.description: Set or update a decision in the shared context. Auto-detects numeric vs string values. Supports tags, layers, scopes, and version tracking.

agent.description: Name of the agent making the decision (defaults to "system")

layer.description: Architecture layer (presentation, business, data, infrastructure, cross-cutting)

value.description: Decision value (string or numeric). Numeric values are stored in optimized table.

version.description: Version identifier (defaults to "1.0.0"). Used for change tracking.

tools.name: set_decision

tools.description: Retrieve decisions with advanced filtering. Returns token-efficient view with all metadata. Supports filtering by status, layer, tags, and scope.

tag_match.description: Tag matching mode: "AND" (all tags required) or "OR" (any tag)

tags.description: Filter by tags (use tag_match to control AND/OR logic)

tools.name: get_context

tools.description: Get a specific decision by key. Returns full metadata including tags, layer, scopes, version, and timestamp.
tools.name: get_decision

tools.description: Search for decisions by tags with AND/OR logic. Supports flexible tag-based filtering with optional status and layer filters.

match_mode.description: Tag matching mode: "AND" (all tags required) or "OR" (any tag)

tags.description: Array of tags to search for (at least one required)

tools.name: search_by_tags

tools.description: Get version history for a specific decision key. Returns all historical versions ordered by timestamp (newest first).

key.description: Decision key to get version history for

tools.name: get_versions

tools.description: Search for decisions within a specific architecture layer. Supports status filtering and optional tag inclusion.

include_tags.description: Include tag information in results (defaults to true)

tools.name: search_by_layer

tools.description: Send a message from one agent to another (or broadcast to all). Supports priority levels and optional JSON payload.

payload.description: Optional JSON payload with additional data

to_agent.description: Name of the receiving agent (null or omit for broadcast)

tools.name: send_message

tools.description: Retrieve messages for an agent. Returns messages addressed to the agent or broadcast messages. Supports filtering by read status, priority, and message type.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent to retrieve messages for

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (defaults to 50)

unread_only.description: Only return unread messages (defaults to false)

tools.name: get_messages

tools.description: Mark messages as read. Only marks messages addressed to the specified agent (security check). Idempotent operation.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent marking messages as read

message_ids.description: Array of message IDs to mark as read

tools.name: mark_read

tools.description: Record a file change with optional layer assignment and description. Auto-registers the file and agent. Useful for tracking file modifications across agents.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent making the change

change_type.description: Type of change made to the file

tools.name: record_file_change

tools.description: Retrieve file changes with advanced filtering. Supports filtering by file, agent, layer, change type, and time range. Returns token-efficient view when no filters applied.

agent_name.description: Filter by agent who made the change

limit.description: Maximum number of changes to return (default: 100)

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp - return changes since this time

tools.name: get_file_changes

tools.description: Check if a file is "locked" (recently modified). Useful to prevent concurrent edits by multiple agents. Returns lock status with details of last change.

lock_duration.description: Time window in seconds to consider "locked" (default: 300 = 5 minutes)

tools.name: check_file_lock

tools.description: Add a constraint with priority level, optional layer assignment, and tags. Categories: performance, architecture, security. Auto-registers category and agent.
tools.name: add_constraint

tools.description: Retrieve constraints with advanced filtering. Supports filtering by category, layer, priority, tags, and active status. Uses token-efficient view with all metadata.

active_only.description: Only return active constraints (defaults to true)

limit.description: Maximum number of constraints to return (default: 50)

tags.description: Filter by tags (OR logic - matches ANY tag)

tools.name: get_constraints

tools.description: Deactivate a constraint (soft delete). Idempotent - deactivating already-inactive constraint is safe. Constraints are never removed from database.
tools.name: deactivate_constraint

tools.description: Get summary statistics for all architecture layers. Returns decision counts, recent file changes (last 1 hour), and active constraints per layer.
tools.name: get_layer_summary

tools.description: Manually clear old data from the database. Deletes messages older than specified hours and file changes older than specified days. Transaction-safe operation that returns counts of deleted records.

file_changes_older_than_days.description: Delete file changes older than this many days (default: 7)

messages_older_than_hours.description: Delete messages older than this many hours (default: 24)

tools.name: clear_old_data

tools.description: Get comprehensive database statistics including counts for all major tables, active vs total records for decisions and constraints, and overall database health metrics.
tools.name: get_stats

tools.description: Get current auto-deletion configuration settings. Returns weekend-awareness flag, message retention hours, and file history retention days.
tools.name: get_config

tools.description: Update auto-deletion configuration settings. All parameters are optional. Changes take effect immediately for subsequent cleanup operations.

fileHistoryRetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain file change history (1-90 days)

ignoreWeekend.description: Whether to skip weekends when calculating retention periods (true = skip weekends)

messageRetentionHours.description: Number of hours to retain messages (1-168 hours)

tools.name: update_config
